title: the two-member class-descriptor registrars, one row per member
heading: ## Per-member rows: the vtable each two-member descriptor registrar installs, and its reflected type (OPUS, 2026-10-03)
lead: The family `two-member class-descriptor registrars (m_count + m_els)` (frontmatter: 38 members; {N} get a row here) shares one 815-byte form, stated here once and not repeated per row. Under the thread-safe static-init guard (`008092FC` / `0080929C`), each stub constructs its static class descriptor through `00632D80`, stores the `PClassDescriptorAbstract<T>` vtable into it, calls the three member-registration helpers, then replaces that vtable with `PClassDescriptorConcrete<T>`, and goes on to register the `m_count` and `m_els` members and their teardowns. Members differ in every per-class operand of that form (53 instructions: the descriptor, its guard variables, both vtables, the helper arguments, the element descriptor and the teardowns). Each row anchors the first of them that names the class, the `lea rax, [V]` at + 0xA9 whose following `mov` stores the `PClassDescriptorAbstract<T>` vtable V into the descriptor. It states V and T, the template argument named by V's MSVC RTTI complete-object locator, read from the certified image. {CHECK} re-derives every row and compares it with the committed {ROWS}. Two controls are refused: a swapped value and a moved anchor. Members that do not derive are listed in [`excluded.tsv`](../../_index/candidates/opus-ee-two-member-registrars-1003/excluded.tsv).
